lines.text: Would you like to join us for lunch on Wednesday?
lines.speaker: Rae

lines.text: Thanks for asking. I can't make it on Wednesday.
lines.speaker: Bo

lines.text: No problem. We're going for coffee on Friday, too.
lines.speaker: Rae

lines.text: I'd love to join you for coffee. What time?
lines.speaker: Bo

lines.text: At three, at the little café near the station.
lines.speaker: Rae

lines.text: Is that the café next to the bookshop?
lines.speaker: Bo

lines.text: Great. See you there on Friday.
lines.speaker: Bo
